title: TAB Worlds
description: Displays the player's dimension on the tab and adds the corresponding icon based on the dimension.
body:
Requires [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast)
# 
This mod displays the player's dimension on the tab and adds a corresponding icon based on the setting.
- In the config file (located in the game folder), you can disable icons and edit colors.
- Gradients are also available.
- You can disable mod features manually, by using this command: /tabworlds <nick> disable,
or you can re-enable it using this command: /tabworlds <nick> enable.
The mod will save the results of these commands and apply them when you log back into the game or restart the server.
